{{Quote|I'd say about twelve parsecs outside the Rishi Maze, toward the south.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Rishi Maze''', formally known as '''Companion Aurek''', was a satellite dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in the [[Universe/Legends|observable universe]] and was in a [[Extragalactic/Legends|close]] and decaying [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. 

==Astrography==
{{Quote|According to my information, it should appear in this quadrant here, just south of the Rishi Maze|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Rishi.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rishi Maze was a dwarf galaxy in decaying orbit above the galaxy.]]
Vast fields of gravitation, energy, and debris stretched out on all sides of the Rishi Maze. Large cosmic radiation fields, which shifted quickly, spanned the dwarf galaxy.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was said that the only way to access the Rishi Maze was by starting at the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]].<ref name="The Unseen Planets of Episode II">{{InsiderCite|80|The Unseen Planets of Episode II}}</ref>

It was located twelve [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]],<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> toward the galactic north.<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Rishi_Maze-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A view of the Rishi Maze from the surface of the planet Rishi in the galaxy.]]
The satellite dwarf [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] of the Rishi Maze derived its name from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="The Unseen Planets of Episode II" /> However, the Rishi Maze formal name was "Companion Aurek", derived from [[Aurek/Legends|Aurek]], the first letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established [[Firebase Alpha]], an illegal energy-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] station, near a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] inside the Rishi Maze. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were contracted to deliver supplies to the station and passed via the Rashi Maze.<ref name="EAOC">{{InsiderCite|131|Maze Run}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[StarWars.com#DVD-ROM Exclusive Content|Episode II DVD-ROM Exclusive Content]] states that "the cluster known as the Rishi Maze may be the bright object that Luke and Leia stare at the end of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']]." However, [[Leland Chee]] confirmed on the [[StarWars.com]] [[StarWars.com Message Boards|Message Boards]] that the object seen in ''Episode V'' is [[The galaxy/Legends|the ''Star Wars'' galaxy]],<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=118855&start=281#4612881|thread=Galaxy Map Discussion|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2003-08-18|time=8:59 AM}}</ref> despite this requiring the Rebel fleet to have traveled a very long distance from the galaxy. However, such a travel is possible according to the [[Outbound Flight Project]] led by Jedi Master [[Jorus C'baoth]]. The Rebel fleet could also ''be'' in the Rishi Maze during this scene, and thus able to view the main galaxy from outside.

The Rishi Maze was given the formal nomenclature of Companion Aurek in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
